name: 陳曉
objective:
能源相關之基本科學原理，能源之應用及未來發展趨勢，非再生能源及再生能源概論，電力與動力系統簡介，能源的有效變換，能源管理，有效能源之解析與評估，能源之使用與環保問題。
Basic scientific principles of energy, its applications and future development. Renewable and non-renewable energy will be discussed in general. General introduction to electricity and power generation. This course will also cover topics in effective energy conversion, energy management, evaluation and analysis of energy effectiveness, and related environmental problems.
schedule:
1. Introduction
2. Fossil fuels - Oil
3. Fossil fuels - Natural gas
4. Fossil fuels - Coal
5. Energy forms and thermodynamics
6. Power generation
7. Combustion
8. Internal combustion engines
9. Renewable energy
10. Energy use and pollution
11. Energy and sustainable development
scorePolicy:
Term report 45%
Term examination 45%
Class performance 10%
materials:
The tutor will provide hand-outs in electronic form (中文)

Reference material
Shepherd, W. and Shepherd, D.W. (2014). Energy Studies, 3rd edn., Imperial College Press.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）SDG13：氣候行動（Climate Action）
